# agent-ready

> Score how ready a codebase is for AI coding agents: 16 deterministic checks, one command,
> a letter grade, and a badge you can commit. Zero dependencies, no network, no LLM.

## Docs
- [README](./README.md): what it measures, the full rubric, and usage
- [Chinese README](./README.zh-CN.md): 中文说明
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents working on this repository
- [Rubric](#): run `agent-ready --rules` for the authoritative scoring table

## Source
- [agent_ready.py](./agent_ready.py): the entire tool (single file, standard library only)
- [tests/test_agent_ready.py](./tests/test_agent_ready.py): the test suite

## Usage in one line
```bash
python3 agent_ready.py . && python3 agent_ready.py . --init
```
